strings: m_c hasn't managed to avoid whitecough, r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. The water {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} inhaled must have been carrying illness with it. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} confined to camp while {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/recover/recovers}.
m_c's hacking no longer seems to be just from the water {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} inhaled. It must have progressed into whitecough.
With {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs already weakened by the water still in them, m_c is unable to fight off the whitecough that finds {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
